title: Kopi Senja Queue App

brief.title: PRD: Kopi Senja Queue App
intro: The Kopi Senja café is always busy. Bu Sekar wants a simple queue app for the till and the in-store screen.
Before writing code, sort the requirements first. Ask about the ambiguous ones; leave out what is out of scope.

items.text: Customers get sequential queue numbers; after 999 it goes back to 1.
items.why: The rule is clear and can be tested right away.

items.text: The screen shows the estimated wait in minutes.
items.why: It is clear what is shown and in which unit.
How many seconds is fast? Ask for a target number, for example the number appears in under 2 seconds.

items.text: It must look nice and modern.
items.why: Nice according to whom? Ask for an example or sketch of the desired look.
The number is exact and can be calculated.

items.text: The queue only runs from 08:00 to 21:00.
items.why: The opening hours are stated clearly.

items.text: Also make a guessing game for waiting customers.
items.why: That is a different project. Note it as an idea; keep it out of this one.

items.text: The app also calculates barista salaries.
items.why: Payroll is not part of a queue system.

cards.title: Sequential queue numbers
cards.story: As a customer, I get a queue number so I know my turn.

cards.title: Fix the bill total
cards.story: As a cashier, I want correct totals for multi-item orders.

cards.title: Estimated wait
cards.story: As a customer, I want to know roughly how long I will wait.

cards.title: Correct opening hours
cards.story: As the owner, I want the queue open only during business hours.

cards.title: Member discount
cards.story: As a member, I get 10% off.

cards.title: Review: order log
cards.story: A teammate asks for a review of the order log PR before merging.

cards.title: Review: queue number tests
cards.story: A PR with extra tests is waiting for review.

cards.title: Rupiah price format
cards.story: As a cashier, I want prices to look tidy like Rp 25.000.

cards.title: Members served first
cards.story: As a member, I want to be served first.

sprints.goal: Customers can take a number and the till totals orders correctly.
The queue screen is ready during opening hours.
Member features and polish before release.
